messages:
Yara: quick flag 1: canary selector tweak rolled at 08:03 and we9re seeing a p95 rise for tiny requests (<=48t). dashboard: https://dash.redwood/ttl/canary-p95 :frown:
Omar: details? batch hist or kvcache signals?
Yara: running_batch_p50 dropped from 4 -> 1.9 on those hosts. kvcache remote-fallbacks up ~2.1%. grpc smallwrite syscall count also ticked up.
Selena: sample trace (trimmed):
```\n08:06:12.100 parse_req     0.6ms
08:06:12.101 tokenize      2.7ms
08:06:12.104 kvcache       0.5ms (miss -> remote 4.3ms)
08:06:12.109 kernel_exec   21.2ms (chosen: fused-vector)
08:06:12.131 grpc_writev   4.7ms (3 frames)
```
Omar: pattern: selector prefers fused-vector (good for long seqs) but for tiny seqs it increases per-request CPU -> reduces concurrency -> more 1-item batches -> thrashes kvcache hot-shards -> remote fetches -> extra smallwrites. feedback loop.
Yara: mitigation ideas: 1) soft-rollback on canary now, 2) add a selector gate: if observed running_batch_p90 < 3 prefer scalar_light kernel, 3) instrument hosts with kernel_variant label + running_batch_hist + kvcache_remote_rate + grpc_smallwrite_count.
Selena: also evaluate a tokenization sidecar for ultra-small requests: removes tokenize from host but adds RPC overhead. we need replay numbers (2k tiny reqs) for both host-tokenize and sidecar-tokenize.
perf-bot: queued replay job replay/1758502460-2k-small-reqs. link: https://replay.redwood/jobs/1758502460 ETA ~4m.
ops-bot: soft-rollback requested and applied to canary at 08:12:10 UTC.
Yara: after rollback metrics trending back to baseline. Follow-ups: RFC to add host_preproc+net estimate into kernel scoring, telemetry change, and CI micro-benchmark for selector rollouts. Closing incident, moving follow-ups to RFC thread. :thumbsup:
